_README: These configurations exist for tooling discovery only. NEVER auto-start the frontend without explicit user approval — Next 16 + Tailwind 4 + PostCSS workers can fork-bomb (3990+ procs observed). To start the frontend, the user must say so explicitly; then use `bash dashboard/scripts/start-frontend.sh --bg` which enforces single-instance + process-group cleanup.

configurations.name: dashboard-frontend
configurations._warning: DO NOT auto-launch. Run `bash dashboard/scripts/start-frontend.sh --bg` instead — it enforces single-instance + reaps the postcss/swc worker group on stop.
